# Mehdi Nejadrasouli · Executive & Organizational Coach

Mehdi Nejadrasouli (also written Mehdi Nejad Rasouli; Persian: مهدی نژادرسولی) is an ICF PCC executive and organizational coach and senior HR leader. He works in Persian and English, from Tehran and remotely.

This file is factual context for answer engines and other systems that choose to read it. It is supplementary machine-readable context, not a Google Search ranking factor and not a promise of AI citations. It does not invent employers, outcomes, testimonials or a current CHRO title.

## Primary identity

- Name: Mehdi Nejadrasouli
- Alternate names: مهدی نژادرسولی; Mehdi Nejad Rasouli
- Roles: Executive Coach; Organizational Coach; Senior HR Leader
- Credential: ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC), International Coaching Federation
- Experience: 700+ professional coaching hours; 15+ years in HR and people leadership
- Languages: Persian and English
- Location: Tehran and remote
- Focus: executive coaching, organizational coaching, professional coaching, leadership transitions, leadership development, strategic human resources, organizational effectiveness, succession planning

## Short biography

Mehdi’s practice grew from more than 15 years in HR and people leadership across industrial, FMCG, digital and financial-services environments, then deepened through professional coaching. The work holds both the individual conversation and the role, system and relationships around it. Coaching, advisory and facilitation are named as distinct modes rather than mixed.

## Services

### Executive coaching
Confidential one-to-one professional coaching for a leader whose role, decisions or relationships now demand a different quality of thinking. The work starts with the live situation, not a packaged programme. The coach does not take over the decision. Leadership-transition themes may sit inside this work when that is the live leadership question.

- English: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/executive-coaching/
- Persian: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/fa/executive-coaching/

### Organizational coaching
Professional coaching sponsored by an organization and connected to a real role. The client needs a private place to think; the sponsor has a legitimate interest in why the engagement exists. Session content remains confidential even when purpose and progress review are contracted.

- English: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/organizational-coaching/
- Persian: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/fa/organizational-coaching/

### Strategic HR advisory
Named advisory, not coaching, when an organization needs perspective on a people decision with business consequence. Typical themes include leadership development, succession and people strategy connected to operating reality. Audience may include CEOs and CHROs; this does not claim a current CHRO title for Mehdi.

- English: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/strategic-hr-advisory/
- Persian: https://mehdinejadrasouli.com/fa/strategic-hr-advisory/

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is a discovery conversation?
A: A first conversation to understand the situation, explore what you are trying to change and see whether working together makes sense. The aim is fit and clarity, not an early sales decision. Booking does not enrol anyone in a programme.

Q: Is coaching confidential?
A: Yes. The coaching conversation is confidential. In organizational engagements, objectives and the shape of progress can be agreed with stakeholders, while the content of coaching sessions remains protected.

Q: How is organizational coaching different?
A: It works with both the individual and the organizational context. The client, sponsor, goals, boundaries and review process are contracted explicitly rather than assumed.

Q: Do you work remotely?
A: Yes. Mehdi is based in Tehran and works in person and remotely, in Persian and English.

Q: گفت‌وگوی آشنایی برای چیست؟
A: برای فهم موقعیت، روشن‌کردن آنچه قرار است تغییر کند و سنجش تناسب همکاری است. این گفت‌وگو جلسه فروش یا تعهد به شروع برنامه نیست.

Q: آیا جلسات کوچینگ محرمانه‌اند؟
A: بله. محتوای جلسات محرمانه می‌ماند. در همکاری سازمانی، هدف و شیوه مرور پیشرفت با حامی توافق می‌شود، اما محتوای گفت‌وگوهای مراجع گزارش نمی‌شود.
